;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]]
**A double car bombing in [[Benghazi]], [[Libya]], kills at least 33 people and wounds "dozens" of others. The victims include both military personnel and civilians, according to local officials. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/twin-car-bombs-kill-more-than-20-in-libyas-benghazi-officials-idUSKBN1FC2TC (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[90th Academy Awards]]
**The nominations for the upcoming [[Academy Awards]] are announced. Among the films nominated as the best of [[2017 in film]], ''[[The Shape of Water (film)|The Shape of Water]]'' leads with thirteen nominations, with ''[[Dunkirk (2017 film)|Dunkirk]]'' following behind with eight nominations. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/01/23/entertainment/oscars-2018-analysis/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Russia]]'s [[Ministry of Culture (Russia)|Ministry of Culture]] bars the release of the British–French [[political satire]] film ''[[The Death of Stalin]]'' in the country after accusing the film of containing "ideological warfare" and "extremist" content. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42793157 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
*[[World Economic Forum]]
**Various billionaires, world leaders, and investors gather in [[Davos]], [[Switzerland]] to discuss economic issues. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/photo-essays/2018-01-23/the-2018-world-economic-forum-arrives-in-davos-in-pictures (''Bloomberg'')]
*[[Trans-Pacific Partnership]]
**The 11 remaining countries aiming to create the Trans-Pacific Partnership after the United States' withdrawal announce that they will sign an agreement in [[Chile]] this March. [https://in.reuters.com/article/trade-tpp-japan/trans-pacific-trade-pact-without-u-s-to-be-signed-in-march-japan-idINKBN1FC17S (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Alaska earthquake]]
**A 7.9 [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude]] earthquake occurs in the [[Gulf of Alaska]]. A [[Tsunami warning system|tsunami warning]] is issued for coastal [[Alaska]] and [[British Columbia]], and the entire [[West Coast of the United States|U.S. West Coast]] is placed under a tsunami watch. Areas of Alaska remain under a tsunami advisory. It is tied as the [[List of earthquakes in the United States|sixth-largest earthquake]] ever recorded in the [[United States]], but there are no reports of significant damage or fatalities. [http://news.sky.com/story/tsunami-warning-after-huge-alaska-quake-11219220 (Sky News UK)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/tsunami-warning-for-much-alaska-coast-follows-earthquake-live-updates/ (CBS News)] [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us2000cmy3#executive (USGS)]
*A helicopter and a light aircraft collide mid-air close to the [[Philippsburg Nuclear Power Plant]] in [[Germany]], killing four people. [http://www.dw.com/en/helicopter-light-aircraft-collide-in-southwestern-germany/a-42271947 (Deutsche Welle)]
*Three people, two employees of a [[television]] company and a [[Brazilian Air Force]] sergeant, are killed when their [[Robinson R44]] crashes into the sea at Praia de Pina, [[Recife]], [[Pernambuco]], [[Brazil]]. [https://g1.globo.com/pe/pernambuco/noticia/globocop-cai-na-orla-da-zona-sul-do-recife.ghtml (G1)] [https://asn.flightsafety.org/wikibase/204957 (Aviation Safety Network)]

;International relations
*[[Haiti–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] closes its [[List of diplomatic missions of the United States#Americas|embassy]] in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]], due to large-scale [[Protests against Donald Trump|protests]] against the [[Foreign policy of the first Donald Trump administration|policy]] of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://armenpress.am/eng/news/919872/us-embassy-in-haiti-closed-due-to-anti-trump-protests.html (AP via ''Armenpress'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2018 Marshall County High School shooting]]
**A [[school shooting]] at Marshall County High School in [[Draffenville, Kentucky|Draffenville]], [[Kentucky]] kills two people and injures 19. The suspect is arrested. [http://www.foxnews.com/us/2018/01/23/kentucky-high-school-shooting-leaves-at-least-one-dead-and-multiple-wounded-officials-say.html (Fox News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]]
**[[Theresa May]] criticizes [[Boris Johnson]] for airing [[National Health Service]] funding concerns outside private [[Cabinet of the United Kingdom|U.K. Cabinet]] meetings. [https://in.reuters.com/article/britain-politics-health/britains-may-slaps-down-foreign-minister-over-health-funds-idINKBN1FC1JR (Reuters)]
*[[Venezuelan presidential election, 2018]]
**The National Constituent Assembly approved a decree that calls for presidential elections before April 30. Incumbent [[Nicolás Maduro]] says he will compete for re-election. [http://www.businessinsider.com/venezuela-embattled-president-nicolas-maduro-set-to-run-for-reelection-2018-1 (Business Insider)]
*The [[United States Senate]] confirms [[Jerome Powell]] as chairman of the [[Federal Reserve Bank]] with 84 votes for and 13 against. [https://mobile.nytimes.com/2018/01/23/us/politics/fed-nominee-is-asked-why-he-erred-in-forecasting-inflation-he-didnt-answer.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Politics of Guatemala]]
**[[Jimmy Morales|President Jimmy Morales]] is questioned about the high costs he spends to buy food and other luxury items. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-42789249 (BBC)]

;Science and technology
*[[Google Lunar X Prize]]
**The organizers of the [[Google]] [[Missions to the Moon|Lunar]] [[X Prize Foundation|X Prize]] announce that the $20 million grand prize for a commercial [[Moon landing|lunar lander]] will expire on 31 March 2018 without a winner because none of its five finalist teams would be able to launch a mission before the deadline. [http://spacenews.com/google-lunar-x-prize-to-end-without-winner/ (Space News)]

;Sports
*[[2017–18 NBA season]]
**[[LeBron James]] of the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] scores his 30,000th career regular-season point in a loss to the [[2017–18 San Antonio Spurs season|San Antonio Spurs]]. James becomes the youngest player to reach the milestone at age {{age in years and days|1984|12|30|2018|1|23}}, surpassing [[Kobe Bryant]]'s previous record of {{age in years and days|1978|8|23|2012|12|5}}. [https://www.si.com/nba/2018/01/23/cavaliers-lebron-james-scores-30000-points (''Sports Illustrated'')]
